items.title_orig: Just finished S1 rewatch and THE MUSIC
items.article_text:
From Pearl Jam ending ep 1 to Radiohead closing out the season, this show is hitting me where it hurts. The brilliant way they used REM in season 2 alone has made me turn multiple people on to this show. 
 I’m very old, and The Bear has integrated music in a way I’ve never seen before. 
    submitted by    /u/JaggedLittleGil    to    r/TheBear  
 [link]   [comments]
